newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RTZ-CRA says no forex hedge on future divs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RTZ-CRA says no forex hedge on future divs.

text.p: RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd said on Thursday dividends would not be protected from exchange rate risks from the 1997 year onward.
Executive chairman Robert Wilson said British shareholders' 1996 dividends were protected from adverse U.S. dollar/sterling exchange rate movements.

"In future ... there will be no such mitigation and the dividends will be fully determined in U.S. dollars despite the either rise or fall in the amount paid in sterling or Australian dollars," Wilson told a televised news conference from London.
Wilson said if the company had not compensated British shareholders for the exchange losses, it would have resulted in the first cut in dividends in the history of RTZ since 1962.
